value.rationale: The oloid and its entire symmetric-separation family are naturally motivated classical convex bodies. The singular change of a random width-tail exponent at separation zero and the closed matched boundary layer provide nontrivial precise information absent from the previously calculated mean widths, and the conditional normal law quantifies orientation selection. This is more than a restatement of the source support formula or a minor numerical improvement.
